candidate_universe_fixed_before_search: All unordered pairs among finite-scored non-country predictors were candidates after fixed predictor universe.

capability_law_recovered_for_target: Recursive search may be data-directed after authority fixes split grammar/frontier, but branch coverage, support, stop and membership/replay must be explicit; recursion must not silently privilege one deviation tunnel as universal law.
